options.content:
## Instances
The running Flowrensic instances, and what each one uses and logs.

spec.title: Running instances
spec.description: One row for each instance the flowrensic job scrapes. Up is 1 when it answers and 0 when it does not.

spec.title: CPU load by instance
spec.description: CPU cores each instance uses.

spec.title: Memory used by instance
spec.description: Memory the Go runtime of each instance holds.

spec.title: Network data volume per second by instance (total)
spec.description: Bytes read plus bytes written, by instance.

spec.title: Network data volume per second by instance (in / out)
spec.description: Bytes read and bytes written, by instance.

spec.title: Requests per second to instance
spec.description: HTTP requests each instance answered.

spec.title: Response latency p95 by instance
spec.description: The p95 of the time each instance took to answer a Connect call.

spec.title: Errors per second by instance
spec.description: Log lines each instance wrote at error.

spec.title: Warns per second by instance
spec.description: Log lines each instance wrote at warn.

spec.title: Goroutines leak detector by instance
spec.description: A line that keeps climbing and does not come back down is a leak.

options.content:
## Storage
The database on the left and the blob storage on the right.

spec.title: Database storage used volume
spec.description: Size of the Postgres database.

spec.title: Blob storage used volume
spec.description: Size of the history files or objects.

spec.title: Database storage total records
spec.description: Rows in the database, over every kind.

spec.title: Blob storage used total items
spec.description: History files or objects the blob backend holds.

spec.title: Database evicted items
spec.description: Rows retention deleted in the time range shown.

spec.title: Blob evicted items
spec.description: History objects retention deleted in the time range shown, one for each run.

options.content:
## Sustainability
Whether each server keeps up with its work (FPP-135): its load against its limits, the database connections, the calls and jobs, and the storage against its size limit.

spec.title: CPU used against the CPU limit by instance
spec.description: CPU cores each instance uses, and the cores its cgroup may use. A server with no CPU limit shows the use alone.

spec.title: Memory used against the memory limit by instance
spec.description: Memory each instance uses, and the memory its cgroup may use. A server with no memory limit shows the use alone.

spec.title: Times throttled per second by instance
spec.description: How often the cgroup of each instance reached its CPU limit and was held back.

spec.title: Calls running now by kind of call by instance
spec.description: Calls each instance is answering right now. A line that keeps going up means calls arrive faster than the instance finishes them.

spec.title: Database connections in use and free by pool by instance
spec.description: Connections of each Postgres pool, in use and free.

spec.title: Time waited for a connection per second by pool by instance
spec.description: Seconds queries waited for a free connection of the pool, per second.

spec.title: Connections of all servers against max_connections
spec.description: Connections every Flowrensic server holds on Postgres together, and the max_connections of Postgres.

spec.title: Storage used against the size limit
spec.description: The database and the history files together, and the size limit of the store.

spec.title: Work waiting by job by instance
spec.description: Work each job counts as waiting. A line that keeps growing means the job falls behind.

spec.title: Last pass against the interval by job by instance
spec.description: How long the last pass of each job took, divided by its interval. Above 1 a pass took longer than its interval.

spec.expr: sum by (instance, task, scope) (flowrensic_job_pass_duration_seconds) / sum by (instance, task, scope) (flowrensic_job_interval_seconds)

spec.title: The largest tables by size
spec.description: Size on disk of each of the largest tables of the database, with its indexes.

spec.title: Calls refused per second by priority by instance
spec.description: Calls the server refused while it sheds load, by priority: urgent, normal and bulk.

spec.title: Call time p95 by kind of call by instance
spec.description: The time 95% of the calls of each kind took at most, against the call time limit, which is checked for each kind (FLOWRENSIC_LIMIT_CALL_TIME).
